summary.headline: Saturn with Mars and the Sun
summary.text: Astrological judgments on Saturn’s conjunctions with Mars and the Sun, including bodily illness, failed works, paternal death and property loss, harm to brothers, enmity, sudden dangers, and agricultural fortune. Valens and Ptolemy are cited, with conditions involving angularity, houses, terms, Jupiter, Venus, and the three-degree limit.
